title: P2b enumerate registered workspaces for sweeps loops dashboard
summary: P2b of deprecating the daemon global workspace pointer. Added registeredWorkspaces() in daemon.js: reads workspaces.json (the WORKSPACES_FILE registry written by setWorkspace) and unions active-loop workspaces; deliberately does NOT include state.workspace unless it is itself registered. The decideAll loop tick, the periodic claim-sweep interval, and the filedrop-stub-sweep interval all switched from "active-loop workspaces UNION state.workspace" to iterating registeredWorkspaces(). Dashboard (public/graph.html): added a WS_RESOLVED gate so tick()/tick_resilient() never fetch /state until an explicit workspace is chosen — resolveExplicitWorkspace() auto-selects the lone registered ws or renders showWorkspaceGate() picker; selectWorkspace() is the single chokepoint that pins WS + updates the URL. Scope held to P2b: state.workspace/state.overlay NOT removed (P3), and route-handler GET fallbacks (?workspace= || state.workspace) left intact since hard-400 enforcement is explicitly P3 — only ensured no NEW silent global reads. All silent-fallback seams from note-mqi776tiyd5 (targetOverlay, sweepStaleClaims/FailedTasks/StaleVerdicts/StaleGuidance/FiledropStubs, decideOne) confirmed: the sweep callers now feed the registered set; the per-seam warn fallbacks remain as P1 instrumentation for any straggler explicit-less caller (to be removed in P3).
